mainEntity.name: How much does a TBI attorney cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most TBI attorneys, including our firm, work on a contingency fee basis. This means you do not pay any upfront legal fees. Instead, the attorney's fees are a percentage of the compensation recovered for your case, whether through a settlement or a court award. If no compensation is recovered, you generally owe no attorney fees. This arrangement allows individuals to pursue justice without the burden of hourly legal costs, ensuring access to legal representation regardless of financial situation. Case-related expenses are typically advanced by the firm and reimbursed from the settlement.
